profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 35 (small New Albany OH Vantage bare-name side campaign): added an operator-confirmed campus address, corrected a groundbreaking date discrepancy against a prior sessions differently dated claim without deleting it, recorded planned (not current) campus and per-building capacity. research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This registry operator record, Vantage, in New Albany, Ohio, matches a specific Vantage Data Centers project confirmed on the companys own site. This registry carries a separate, larger operator record named Vantage Data Centers, and this shorter named Vantage record for the same New Albany, Ohio project is very likely the same company recorded under an inconsistent shortened name rather than a distinct operator, not merged here per this projects no-delete, no-merge-on-name-alone policy. Vantage Data Centers was established in June 2010 with an investment from Silver Lake Partners, and DigitalBridge acquired the company in March 2017. Vantages own current page for this campus (operator source, tier-1, https://www.vantage-dc.com/data-center-locations/north-america/new-albany-ohio/) gives the campus address as 3325 Horizon Court, New Albany, OH 43031, a 70 acre site totaling more than 1.5 million square feet, designed for 192 MW of critical IT load across three data center buildings at 64 MW each. Baxtel, an aggregator, gives a differing house number for the same campus, 3475 Horizon Ct, this is treated as a likely transcription difference against the operators own 3325 figure, which is preferred here. A Vantage press release, dated October 25, 2024 per its own URL and hosted on Businesswire, states the campus broke ground on that date, this corrects a prior research passs differently dated claim of a March 2024 groundbreaking recorded elsewhere in this rows own profile history, that earlier claim is left in place per this projects no-delete policy but this October 25, 2024 date, sourced directly from the operators own press release, is treated as the more reliable figure. The same press release and the operators own campus page agree the first of the three buildings was targeted to open in late 2025, specifically by December 2025 per the operators campus page, with additional phases rolling out through 2028. Since today is after that original target date and no independent confirmation of actual completion was found in sourcing checked this session, this building is not asserted as operational, the target completion date having passed is noted, but actual delivery is not verified. Because the entire 192 MW figure, and the 64 MW per-building figure, describe a campus still under phased construction through 2028 rather than a confirmed current operating capacity, these are recorded as a planned capacity, not applied to critical_it_mw. This specific row, Building 1, is one of the three buildings on this shared campus, all three buildings share the same campus street address, this registry does not have separate street addresses for individual buildings within the campus.
